en: Collaborative Reasoning Engine: A Product Exploration
zh: 多智能体协同思考引擎：一个面向高质量决策的 AI 产品设想

excerpts.zh: 在多个 AI 之间复制粘贴时，用户实际上承担了消息传递的工作。
excerpts.en: Copying between AIs makes the user responsible for passing messages.

excerpts.zh: 协同思考引擎的设想，是帮助用户组织观点，而不只是访问模型。
excerpts.en: The reasoning-engine concept organizes perspectives rather than merely providing model access.

excerpts.zh: 先提取观点，可以减少直接阅读多份长回答的负担。
excerpts.en: Extracting claims first can reduce the burden of reading several long responses.

excerpts.zh: 解释分歧的来源，比只统计有多少模型同意更有用。
excerpts.en: Explaining why models disagree can be more useful than counting votes.

excerpts.zh: 分歧可能来自事实、价值立场、时间尺度或风险偏好。
excerpts.en: Disagreement can arise from facts, values, time horizons or risk preferences.

excerpts.zh: 模型之间的反馈，应该比简单并列回答多提供一些价值。
excerpts.en: Feedback between models should add value beyond parallel responses.

excerpts.zh: 不同类型的问题，可以采用不同的讨论流程。
excerpts.en: Different kinds of questions can use different discussion processes.

excerpts.zh: 用户需要能够决定继续查证、保留分歧或结束讨论。
excerpts.en: Users should be able to investigate further, preserve disagreement or end the discussion.

excerpts.zh: 最小原型可以先尝试独立回答、交叉评价和观点整理。
excerpts.en: A minimal prototype can start with independent responses, cross-review and synthesis.

excerpts.zh: 模型因为相似训练数据形成的一致，不等于证据充分。
excerpts.en: Agreement caused by similar training data is not the same as strong evidence.

excerpts.zh: 多模型、多轮讨论需要考虑额外成本和等待时间。
excerpts.en: Multiple models and discussion rounds add cost and waiting time.

excerpts.zh: 评估这类产品，还要看用户是否理解分歧并保留判断权。
excerpts.en: Evaluation should ask whether users understand disagreements and retain judgment.
